title: 3-Colouring Graphs Excluding a Fixed Minor
summary: We show that, for every fixed graph $H$, every $n$-vertex graph $G$ that excludes $H$ as a minor is $3$-colourable with clustering $O_H(n^{4/9})$. That is, there exists a function $f$ such that for every graph $H$, every $n\ge 1$, every $n$-vertex graph $G$ that excludes $H$ as a minor has a vertex colouring with $3$ colours in which each monochromatic component has size at most $f(H)\cdot n^{4/9}$.
